title: Review guide
description: LLM-generated narrated review guide over a PR diff. Hunks are enumerated by tooling; chunks are model output validated to be an exact partition of the hunks.

diff_hash.description: sha256 of the raw diff text. Cache key for the whole guide.

id.description: Diff ID, PR number, or revset, per kind.

hunks.description: Enumerated by tooling from the raw diff, never by the model.

id.description: Stable hunk ID: '<path>#h<index>', index is the hunk's position within its file.

old.description: [start, end] line range on the old side.

new.description: [start, end] line range on the new side.

context_fn.description: Enclosing function/class name, when tooling can find it.

chunks.description: Model output. Validator enforces: hunk_ids across all chunks form an exact partition of hunks[].id. Order is reading order.

kind.description: Renderer collapses 'mechanical' by default. Validator appends a forced trailing mechanical chunk for any unassigned hunks.

narrative.description: One paragraph. Intent first, then consequence. Never reproduces code.

anchors.description: Line-anchored claims from the narrative, rendered as links into the diff.

line.description: New-side line number; negative means old side (abs value).

linking_symbol.description: Shared symbol that justifies grouping these hunks. Required for multi-file chunks, by the validator.

hunk_ids.description: Member hunks, in display order within the chunk.

narration_cache_key.description: sha256 over member hunk contents. Re-narrate only when this changes.
